<script is:inline>
    (function () {
      var h = document.querySelector('header.top'), b = h && h.querySelector('.nav-toggle'); if (!b) return;
      function set(o) { h.classList.toggle('open', o); b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', o ? 'true' : 'false'); b.textContent = o ? 'Close' : 'Menu'; }
      b.addEventListener('click', function () { set(!h.classList.contains('open')); });
      document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') set(false); });
      h.querySelector('.nav').addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target.closest('a')) set(false); });
    })();
  </script>
  <SearchBox />
</body>
